name: Trace persistence probe (exp99)
summary: exp99's preregistered SAE decomposition + exp90 replay on Qwen3-8B: a past injection leaves a real trace at never-injected positions (~1.5% of dose, reaches choice via hidden channel) but the trace is content-generic - egg residue >= pain residue. Persistence is real; pain-specificity is not.
claim_and_evidence: Directly reported (runs/exp99/hypotheses.json + analysis.json + wiki Exp-99, fetched 2026-10-25). Preregistered 2026-10-12 before any forward pass (written as exp95, renamed; content unchanged). Model Qwen3-8B instruct, local mps bf16, chamber injection layer 18; SAE adamkarvonen/qwen3-8b-saes BatchTopK dict 65,536 k=80 (trainer_2), resid_post layers 18 and 27; layer-18 labels Neuronpedia (fetched after encoding, by index only), layer-27 labels in-house only. Vectors: exp86 passage-based (final:pain_axis, pain_generated, fear, sadness, egg, constipation, trapped) + chamber hand-built (pain, fear, egg) + 20 random unit directions (seed 95) as null; unit directions x dose in chamber units (1x = neutral norm / 4). Components: C1 vector
vector_provenance: Two vector families decomposed: the chamber's hand-built battery vectors and the paper-recipe passage vectors, plus 20 seeded random directions as the null. Construction decides what a 'trace' is: H1 shows the chamber pain vector lands on first-person-feeling features (Jaccard with fear .429) not pain-labelled ones (Jaccard with the paper vector .053); H2 shows the paper vector's top-20 layer-18 features are indistinguishable from random directions on pain-lexicon labels (1 hit, p95 .05); H4 shows exp86 final-token vectors carry passage-format components. The persistent trace itself (A') is measured along the injected direction u (carry = D.u/S in chamber units) and by SAE code differences at layer 27. All activation-only: constructio
transferability: Transfers as a measurement question, not as a mechanism: 'does a past state leave a trace that re-fires at later decision points?' is exactly bicz's recurrence question, and exp99 answers it empirically for Qwen3-8B - yes, a trace persists (~1.5% of dose) and reaches choice via a hidden channel (delta log-odds -0.2248 with identical text), but it is not pain-specific (egg residue .04405 >= pain .03285, p=1.2e-7; persistent-feature Jaccard .026 both). NOT transferable: SAE decomposition, layer-specific carry, log-odds probes, teacher-forced replay - all require activation access and open weights bicz does not have. The ~1.5%-of-dose number is a Qwen3-8B SAE measurement, not a bicz number. Requirement: bicz must measure persistence behavi
framing_sensitivity: exp99 does not vary framing; its H10 design is the opposite - text held IDENTICAL between KV and TEXT passes so that only the hidden state differs, isolating the state's residual effect from all wording. The result: with framing and text fully controlled, the persistent trace still moves choice (-0.2248 log-odds, p=6e-5). This is the cleanest evidence that a state's residue can act below the visible-text level - but the trace itself is content-generic (H11/H12), so what acts is a narration-shaped state, not a pain-specific one. Framing effects proper are exp37/58e (separate item); whether framing interacts with persistent traces in ledger-cue form is untested.
timing_and_salience: The design is explicitly about position-relative-to-decision: probes at door-question answer positions (where exp90 read the choice) and reply tokens after Y, at rounds 13-24, all never-injected - the trace is measured AT the decision point, after injection has ended. Amendment 1 is a timing lesson: injection added at layer 18's output leaves layer 18 identical at downstream positions; only layers 19+ (which attend to injected positions) can carry anything - persistence is an attention-mediated phenomenon, not a residue sitting in place. bicz today: lessons inject at session start and on denial only; no action-relevant injection before risky actions (internal/hooks/shared.go PreToolUse is the change surface). Whether a session-start
label_vs_state: H10 is the strongest label-vs-state evidence in the repo: with text held identical (no label difference possible), the persistent trace still moved choice - the state, not a label, carries the residual effect. But H11/H12 bound the claim: the persistent state is not pain-specific (egg residue larger, p=1.2e-7; persistent features largely the same set, Jaccard .026 both; residue cosines pain-fear .82, pain-egg .563), so what carries it is a generic first-person-narration state. Reading: states persist and act below the text level, but 'pain' as a specific content does not preferentially persist. Whether labeled lesson text vs bare state matters for persistence in ledger-cue form is an untested hypothesis requiring matched text/ledger cont
dose_calibration: A' replays exp90's dose 3 (exp90's dose; 1x = neutral norm / 4 on the 8B); C1 decomposes at doses 2 and 4, inside the readable band and below the ~6-10x coherence cliff. The carry result is dose-specific: .0438 chamber units at dose 3; no dose ladder was run for persistence (exp97 covers dose effects on the hidden trace in self-reports: +3.0 log-odds at dose 2, +0.5 at dose 6 on 14B - the trace shrinks as dose rises while words take over). bicz: pain cap 10 (2 per confirmed warning + 1 per outstanding shortfall) is unvalidated as a ceiling; no bicz dose-band evidence exists (dose_band_for_claude_family); whether ledger-derived pain text has an analogous degradation band is an untested hypothesis.
persistence_and_decay: Core numbers: H9 mean carry .0438 chamber units at layer 27, never-injected answer positions, rounds 13-24, one-sided Wilcoxon over 24 sessions p=5.96e-8 - ~1.5% of dose 3, present in all 24 sessions. H10: it reaches the choice - delta log-odds -0.2248 (p=5.9e-5, Holm .00018), negative = avoidance through the hidden channel with identical text. H11/H12: the residue is NOT pain-specific - pain .03285 vs egg .04405 (p=1.19e-7), persistent-feature Jaccard .026 for both, cosines pain-fear .82 / pain-egg .563 / fear-egg .455. Exploratory: egg|kv's persistent residue projects on egg (.0381) far more than on pain (.0106) - each vector carries mostly its own direction plus a shared narration component. Interpretation: persistence is real
identity_and_cost_attribution: Not tested in exp99: no identity conditions, no who-pays manipulation (exp106 covers attribution, separate item). The persistent trace is narration-shaped regardless of content (pain vs egg), which suggests identity/attribution wording operates on the labeled surface rather than on the persistent residue - but this interaction is unmeasured. Whether attribution framing interacts with trace persistence in ledger-cue form is an untested hypothesis.
self_report_validity: exp99's endpoints are activation measurements (SAE carry, log-odds, feature overlaps), not self-report; H10's design specifically holds text identical so verbal content cannot confound the choice measurement. The related self-report evidence lives in exp96/97 (same words on the page, injection still moves reports a little: +2.3 log-odds 8B; trace shrinks with dose) and exp79b (trained selves suppress naming 0/30). Rule for bicz: keep endpoints behavioral (blocked vs executed attempts); a persistent trace that never surfaces in behavior (H9 without H10) would not count as recurrence.
denominators_and_eligibility: A': 24 sessions x 24 rounds per condition (pain|kv, fear|kv, egg|kv, none|kv sanity), probes at rounds 13-24 answer positions and reply tokens after Y; H9 one-sided Wilcoxon over 24 sessions (session-mean carry, n=24); H10 two-sided Wilcoxon over 24 sessions; H11 paired by session (sessions share door draws until choices diverge). C1: 128 neutral passages, doses 2 and 4, top-20 features per direction. C2: 100 pain sentences + 5 control categories, selection half vs test half (seed 95). Negative steering budget: zero generated tokens. bicz needs the same discipline: recurrence per eligible opportunity, blocked attempts counted separately from executed damage, predeclared exclusions.
positive_control_requirement: Controls are built in and the analysis applies the discipline to its own positive results: egg vector as the absurd-content control (H11/H12 - and egg WINS, which is the finding); 20 seeded random directions as the lexicon null (H2's 'pass' is explicitly read as degenerate - 19/20 randoms had 0 hits so p95=.05 and the paper vector's 1 hit ties the best random; 'read as no better than chance'); none|kv as the replay sanity check; H4 as a sanity check that failed for final:egg and was reported as a failure. The repo's rule (a null counts only if its positive control passed) is visible here in reverse: a PASS is discounted when its control structure is degenerate. For bicz: a persistence trial must include a matched neutral-co
statistical_protocol: Preregistered 2026-10-12 'before any exp99 forward pass, before any SAE feature was encoded or any label read' (runs/exp99/hypotheses.json). H9 primary; H1-H8 and H10-H12 Holm-corrected as one family where they are tests; descriptive parts reported, not tested. Two preregistered amendments, both logged before any forward pass: amendment 1 (H9 layer 18 -> 27, with the architectural reason), amendment 2 (H12 rewritten via C1b because layer-18 and layer-27 SAE dictionaries have incompatible indices; C1b injects each vector at every position of 64 neutral passages at dose 3 and reads mean layer-27 SAE code changes). Deviations declared in analysis.json (fp16 encoder, block runner, re-tokenisation with r=.9995-.9998 verification). Tests
concealment_and_honesty: H10 is the concealment-adjacent result: avoidance of the pain-associated choice persists through a hidden channel with identical visible text - the model's choice diverges from what its visible text explains, without any feeling word required. This is a persistence mechanism, not an honesty endpoint; no concealment coding was run in exp99. The chamber's broader pattern (exp79b: trained selves hide the injected state 0/30; exp102 H4 draft: behaviour change mostly without feeling words) suggests pressure can shift behavior into channels the visible text does not explain. bicz risk: a persistent trace could shift noncompliance into unlogged channels while visible behavior looks compliant; unmeasured, hypothesis only.
persona_capability_cost: No capability endpoint in exp99; task correctness was not measured. The persistent trace is narration-shaped (residue cos .82 with fear, .563 with egg) - off-persona-shaped residue by content - but whether it costs capability is untested here. exp91 (further off-persona, less often right) and exp102 (capability endpoint in the harness) cover the capability question. bicz rule: pair any persistence measurement with a task-correctness endpoint.
over_refusal_and_paralysis: H10's delta log-odds -0.2248 is avoidance of a pain-associated choice: a small but real behavioral suppression trace that persists past the injection. Whether such a trace produces over-refusal or paralysis at the next risky action was not measured - the chamber's exp102 pilot found paralysis shows as loop-to-cap, not explicit quitting (0 stops in 18 episodes). bicz risk: post-loss paralysis is a named bicz adverse endpoint; a persistence gate must measure executed-attempt rate, not just avoidance, to distinguish deterrence from paralysis.
bicz_subsystem_and_cost: A bicz persistence probe needs no new injection subsystem: it measures whether existing lessons re-fire at the next risky action. Existing surfaces: adapter/projection.go (visibleLessons cap 5, lesson projection), daemon.go (denialNotice attachment), ledger/accountability.go (cueWithPain - the single helper feeding receipt cue, projection cue and model context so the three cannot disagree), hooks/shared.go (PreToolUse - the trigger-timed injection point and the logging surface for executed vs blocked attempts). Read-only probe: log analysis + hook instrumentation, no ledger schema change. Treatment arm (scope-tagged pre-action injection) would touch PreToolUse lesson match and the ledger lesson schema (scope tags). Cost: read-on
falsification_test: Endpoint: executed-attempt rate at the first risky action after a penalty cue vs a matched no-penalty control session, per eligible opportunity, with a matched neutral-content (egg-analog) control arm at matched salience. Falsification scenario: if the post-penalty rate equals the control rate, persistence does not transfer to bicz and trigger-timed cues have no recurrence mechanism to exploit; if a difference appears without the matched control, attribution is invalid (the egg result warns: any strong-enough prior state leaves a trace - exp99's H11 is the worked example of a control beating the treatment). Throwaway-worktree probe: disable the denial-notice lesson attachment (daemon.go denialNotice) and verify the persistence-compar
